name: Attuma

abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.True Accuracy: Bu saldırılar Otomatik Blok ve Kaçış (Evade) etkilerini yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Physical Vulnerability: Fiziksel Direnci azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen fiziksel hasarı artırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Vurulunca %15 şansla fiziksel hasarla karşılık verir; siperlenince purify eder ve savunmasını güçlendirir; 20 hidrasyon yükünde durdurulamaz olur. Onu siperleme, hep E1'e zorla. Fiziksel dirençli şampiyonlar avantajlı.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Skill sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Terror of The Deep
Attuma has a [92 - 205]% chance to start the fight with a personal Concussion Debuff. It is paused until he gains a personal Concussion from another ability.
Incoming Bleed Debuffs suffer [50 - 90]% reduced potency.
Attuma's rough skin can now also deal damage any time he strikes his Opponent. In addition, its damage is increased by [5 - 15]% for each Bleed effect on either Champion.
immunityDetails:
• Yakma Bağışıklığı (3 hidrasyon yüküyle) 🔥
• %90 Kanama direnci (imza 200) 🩸
• İyileşme Tersine Çevirmeye dirençli 💚🔄❌

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Attuma's plans can make the best out of the worst situation, or the worst out of the best. All Ability Accuracy modification effects on him have their potencies reversed.

While one of Attuma's personal abilities with a listed chance has over a 100% chance to trigger, the ability has a chance to trigger additional times. Each time, the chance is equal to the former chance -100%. This repeats until the ability fails due to chance.
Attuma's rough Talokanil skin abrades his Opponents with a 25% chance to deal [2,210.12] Physical Damage when they strike him or his Block with a contact attack. Damage scales with Base Attack only.
Whenever an Opponent Evades Attuma while he has less than 1 Bar of Power, he has a 100% chance to instantly gain 15% of his Max Power and passively go Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds.
Attuma's Base Regeneration Rate is 35% instead of the usual 100%. It cannot be lowered further.

abilitySections.title: Hydration - Max Stacks: 20
content: The water in Attuma's Special Attacks grants him stacks of Hydration, which are Passives that fall off one at a time over 8 seconds as Attuma dries out.
With every stack of Hydration, Attuma's Attack Rating is increased by [602.76], and his Regeneration Rate is increased by 1.75%.
At 10 stacks of Hydration, Attuma becomes immune to Incinerate and gains a Precision Passive increasing his Critical Rating by by [2,750].
At 19 stacks of Hydration, Attuma becomes passively Unstoppable.
When he is inflicted with or immune to an Incinerate or Shock, Attuma loses 1 stack of Hydration, and Hydration falls off 30% faster while suffering from Coldsnap.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: 100% chance for Attuma to attempt to Purify 1 non-damaging Debuff, excluding Concussions, and replace it with a Concussion Debuff, reducing Attuma's Ability Accuracy by 50% for 25 seconds. If there are no eligible Debuffs, this ability consumes the oldest stack of Hydration instead.
This ability also triggers when Attuma is inflicted with a Stun or Infuriate Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 100% chance to gain 3 stacks of Hydration.
On activation, 120% chance to gain a True Accuracy Passive. These Passives last 10 seconds and fall off one at a time.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 200% chance to gain 2 stacks of Hydration.
Each hit has a 50% chance to grant Attuma a Cruelty Passive, increasing his Critical Damage Rating by [44.72] for 22 seconds. Can trigger though Block.
Triggering one of these Cruelties pauses Attuma's existing personal Concussions for the Cruelty's duration.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 110% chance to gain 5 stacks of Hydration.
100% chance to inflict a Bleed Debuff on the Opponent, dealing [15,069] Direct Damage over 20 seconds.
When one of these Bleeds fails to apply due to an Immunity, instead inflict a Physical Vulnerability Debuff that reduces the Opponent's Physical Resistance by [1,178.57] for 16 seconds.
